title: 3-Tier Corner glass shelf 8-Inch x 8-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass Hardware Allied Brass
description:
Add vertical storage to tight bathroom corners with a 3-tier corner glass shelf built with solid brass hardware and thick tempered glass. Designed for wall-mounted installation, this piece helps keep daily essentials organized while keeping the floor and vanity area clear. A coordinated option for the foxtrot collection and matching foxtrot bath layouts, it pairs well with textured bathroom hardware and other designer bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Three-tier corner shelf design adds storage and organization in compact spaces
- 3/8-Inch thick tempered, beveled-edge glass for safety and strength
- Solid brass hardware for enduring support
- Concealed screw mounting for a clean, finished look
- Mounting hardware included; no assembly required

Specs:
- Dimensions: 8-Inch L x 8-Inch W x 15-Inch H
- Glass thickness: 0.39 in
- Mount type: Wall mount
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Includes: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
